what: Every experimental signal and its gate. mode=observe means it influences NOTHING until real shadow evidence clears the promotion rule — the operator's own spec: no feature affects judgment before it proves it is edge, not noise.

news_signals.promote_rule: shadow hit-rate beats coin-flip at p<0.05 over min_samples

dr_strange.promote_rule: projection direction beats baseline drift over min_samples

lifecycle.promote_rule: state-conditioned MR beats unconditioned MR net-of-fees

regime_conditioning.promote_rule: regime-conditioned entries beat unconditioned net-of-fees (REGIME_AB proof)

style_switching.promote_rule: style-tagged entries (trend vs range) show a win-rate split worth acting on

heatshield_autotune.promote_rule: whatif-optimal floor beats live floor on forward trades

stock_news_ranking.promote_rule: news-ranked blue-chip entries beat trajectory-only entries

rotation_freshness.promote_rule: faster champion rotation beats sticky rotation on realized P&L
